init.fact: pmap_init stores zone allocation result to pv_entry_zone global 0x001f7ae4

enter.fact: checks physical range, derives index from physical address and pmap globals, computes bucket from 0x001f7ab0

empty_bucket.fact: when bucket+0x04 is zero, records virtual address at +0x08, map pointer at +0x04, and zero at +0x00

additional_node.fact: allocates pv_entry_zone node, writes virtual at node+0x08 and map at node+0x04, then prepends node to bucket+0x00

remove_all.fact: checks physical range and derives same bucket

remove_nodes.fact: moves node link/field dwords into bucket or zeros bucket+0x04; freed node uses pv_entry_zone

pte_clear.fact: clears PTE words and calls local pmap update helper after mapping removal
